title: Confirmation-size sensitivity of the multigraph mechanism contrasts

quantities.effect_nats: paired mechanism contrast at the validation-split size J_old (nats)
quantities.ci_low_nats: lower end of its 95% graph-bootstrap interval at J_old (nats)
quantities.units_old: graphs of the validation-split confirmation J_old (graphs)
quantities.graph_variance_share: share of the contrast variance attributable to graphs in the two-way seed-by-graph variance model of Note S24 (fraction)
quantities.holm_p: Holm-adjusted P value of the contrast in the nine-test family of Supplementary Table S14 at the D_confirm size (probability)
quantities.label_survival_probability: probability that the Holm-significant label survives at the D_confirm size under the two-way variance model (probability)

notes: Keys are the contrast identifiers of cm_campaigns.confirmation.FAMILY for the three multigraph benchmarks (Pascal/RH, COCO/RH, Peptides/radius); that registry supplies the D_confirm sizes and the practical margins. The interval at the D_confirm size is computed from these quantities with fixed means (analytical sensitivity, not an observed replication). The paired per-graph arrays and the two-way variance fit go under raw/; deposit with `python -B scripts/export_records.py from-mapping --mapping <confirmation_sensitivity mapping>` once the set is registered for the mapping exporter.
